== Editing ==

No worries! That is what a wiki is all about. No one really owns any of the pages. And if something gets messed up, it is usually pretty easy to fix. Glad to have you here! ----[[User:Mainphramephreak|<span style="color:#000099;"> '''Willie'''</span>]] - [[User Talk:Mainphramephreak|<span style="color:#990099;">'''''HtS'''''</span>]] 12:42, April 15, 2010 (UTC)

Thanks, mate! I've been in absolute love with the series since the moment I finished the prologue of TEotW. It took me four months to finish it, since I was working 3rd shift at the time.
